item.title: (Seeking Greenlights) The rogue Panzer
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes.

Page Type: SCP Article

Page Layout (Optional): SPC Containment procedures -> Description -> Discovery -> Addendum on communication attempt and another on a researchers thoughts about it's motive. Plan on including ACS format as well.

Elevator Pitch: SPC-XXXX is a Panzer Ausf. F built by the German Reich in 1942. When it is free to move, it attempts to reach the grounds of a former soviet WW2 tank factory and once it reaches the location, it begins to fire at the remains of the factory. It may also attempt to destroy surrounding buildings and fire at civilians using its MG34 machine gun.

Central Narrative: The behaviour exhibited by the SCP, the location it tries to reach, and the damage sustained to itself makes researchers wonder about its reasoning and logic.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: This SCP will be one of few WW2 related articles, and only part of a handful of WW2 equipment SCPs. In addition, it will also feature the ACS classification system and an image.
